newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds untraded because of U.S. closure.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds untraded because of U.S. closure.

text.p: Argentine bonds were untraded Monday due to the closure of the U.S. Treasuries market.
Not a single trade in local instruments was recorded on screens.
"Nothing is happening today," said one trader.
The dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 due 2001 finished Friday at 125.25, up $0.15. The FRB Brady bond due 2005 which is traded abroad slipped 1/8 to 89.
